query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine the allowable material stress values for stainless steel separators operating at cryogenic temperatures, considering changes in material properties due to low temperatures and ensuring safe and compliant design.

communication_strategy.information_flow: Exchange of material data and regulatory standards
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Iterative assessment and validation of material stresses against safety standards
